mapper.select: select p.id, p.source_product_name sourceProductName, p.product_factory_id productFactoryId, mpf.factory_name productFactoryName, p.source_product_code sourceProductCode, p.source_product_url sourceProductUrl, p.head_img_url headImgUrl, p.logistics_name logisticsName, p.freight_cost freightCost, p.source_price sourcePrice, p.dispatch_time dispatchTime, p.steady_status steadyStatus, p.eval_with_image_count evalWithImageCount, p.supplier_name supplierName, p.repurchase_rate repurchaseRate, p.sales_count salesCount, p.category_name categoryName, p.keyword keyword, p.trust_years trustYears, p.source_factory_id sourceFactoryId, p.crawl_time crawlTime, p.platform_type platformType from source_product p LEFT JOIN product_factory mpf on mpf.id = p.product_factory_id where p.id = #{id}
